formulas.name: Pure state condition
formulas.when_to_use: To check if a quantum state represented by a density matrix is pure.
assumptions: ρ is a valid density operator

formulas.name: Mixed state condition
formulas.when_to_use: To determine if a quantum state is a statistical mixture of states.
assumptions: ρ is a valid density operator

formulas.name: Expectation value (density operator)
formulas.when_to_use: To calculate the average outcome of measuring an observable A on state ρ.
common_mistakes: Using ρA instead of its trace
